## Who is Isaac and what is DASHP?

Isaac Z Tai, a software engineer, founded DASHP, a SaaS solution for pest control companies' sales teams. DASHP helps manage commissions, track performance, and improve communication, addressing a key pain point in the industry – pay uncertainty for commission-only salespeople.

## The DASHP Idea and Development

The idea stemmed from a friend's need for a commission calculation tool. Isaac initially built a no-code prototype, leading to immediate interest from potential clients. He quit his job to pursue DASHP full-time, iteratively developing the app, leveraging free tiers of services like Retool, Supabase, Vercel, and Expo Application Services.

## Growth Strategy and Revenue Model

DASHP's growth strategy focused on building strong customer relationships and providing exceptional support. The revenue model utilizes a seat-based contract with 'standard' and 'flex' licenses, balancing predictable income with the seasonality of the pest control industry.

Instead of widespread marketing, Isaac prioritized building strong relationships with key clients and focusing on upselling existing contracts.

# Pest control commission software built for summer programs.

Per-account flat rates. Attrition-based clawbacks. Seasonal ramp bonuses. Weekly 1099 statements during the summer push. D2DHQ runs commission payroll for D2D pest teams the way pest actually sells — high-volume, high-churn-risk, mostly 1099, and brutally time-pressured during the season.

Pest control D2D has its own commission grammar. The deal isn't a one-time purchase, it's a recurring service contract; the commission isn't per-watt or per-install, it's a flat $50–$150 per signed account; and the failure mode isn't cancellation, it's 90-day attrition. Teams that try to run pest payroll on generic commission software hit a wall the first time someone asks “why did this account cost me commission twice?”

Most pest D2D pays a flat commission per signed account, with the rate scaling by service frequency:

| Bi-monthly service | $60–$100 per account | 6 treatments per year |
| Quarterly service | $80–$150 per account | 4 treatments per year, higher contract value, higher commission |
| Specialty (termite, mosquito) | $100–$250 per account | Premium treatment plans, longer contracts |
